episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Tine, a self described chic college student, has become the object of desire for a fellow student named Green.  Green relentlessly pursues Tine which sparks Tine's plan to get a fake girlfriend to ward off Green's advances.  When that doesn't work, Tine sets his eyes on a fake boyfriend instead, none other than the handsome and grumpy guitar player, Sarawat.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Tine decides to join the music club to get close to Sarawat, but when the university board limits the maximum number of students in the club Dim has no choice but to hold auditions.  Tine sets out to learn to play to the guitar in a week to secure his future in the club.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: As Green shows no signs of backing off, Tine pushes Sarawat to be more public with his flirting to help repel Green's advances.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Sarawat's brother, Phukong, comes for a visit to learn about the university.  Meanwhile, Mil, Dim, and Sarawat prepare for their performances at the concert.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Sarawat demands that Tine stop pursuing anyone else, including Pearl.  Tine is progressively confused by Sarawat based on his understanding that they are not in a real relationship.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: After Sarawat gives some clues about his true feelings for Tine, Tine devises a plan to test Sarawat's true feelings.  The pair attend the Scrubb concert together.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Green's ex-boyfriend's arrival calls into question the need for Tine and Sarawat to continue their fake romance.  Sarawat reveals the truth about the Scrubb concert meeting one year previously.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Man orchestrates a bargain that if Sarawat wins the soccer game versus Engineering, Tine will confess his feelings.  However, if Sarawat loses the game he must agree to stop pursuing Tine.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: The soccer game between Political Science and Architecture gets physical.  Multiple injuries creates a burden of tough choices to be made.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Tine's brother comes for an unexpected visit.  The end of the tutor camp arrives for Phukong who still hasn't found the opportunity to open up to Min.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Sarawat and Tine join a service trip to plant trees but a string of bad luck seems to follow them there.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Pam's arrival sets Tine on edge, causing him to question what is her relationship to Sarawat.  Pam pushes her way back into Sarawat's life by begging for guitar lessons as she prepares for her audition at the college of music.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Sarawat seeks to earn Tine's trust after the misunderstanding with Pam.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: A year has passed since ctrl S won the music contest and Dim and Fang move on from their roles as president of the music and cheer-leading clubs, respectively. Fang approaches Tine to be the new cheer president, while Dim asks Sarawat to take over for the music club.  In an effort to keep working together, Tine sets a goal to improve his musical skills and audition once again for the club.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: After Fang and other cheerleaders get into an accident, Tine must step up to support the cheer club.  However, when the cheer club and music club are assigned practice rooms next door conflict arises over the use of the space.  Sarawat begins planning a special way to celebrate Tine's birthday, Type is offered a promotion in Phuket, and Phukong tries out for the cheer team to get Mil's attention.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Sarawat takes the music club to Dim's house to practice for a week to help resolve the tension with the cheer team.  Phukong works himself too hard during cheer practice.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: After two weeks of separation to allow CtrlS to practice for the U2 band contest, Sarawat and Tine reunite.  The cheer team performs at the soccer game and Boss gets injured on the field once again.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: The cheer team and music club take a joint trip to the beach to celebrate their collective success at their competitions.  While at the beach, the truth behind Green and Dim's feud is exposed.
